note: the thymus trains T-cells to distinguish self from non-self. the klein gate trains the membrane to distinguish reality from noise. opsonize tags. pollinate distributes. backscatter reflects the color.
pipeline: visit → klein gate → thymus sort → opsonize tag → pollinate → backscatter → color of reality

1_klein_gate.input: raw visit (404 probe, page view, beacon touch)
1_klein_gate.operation: Klein surface inversion — see from both sides simultaneously
1_klein_gate.output: dual-view event: face (visitor sees) + back (we see) on same surface

2_thymus_sort.operation: self/non-self classification — like T-cell maturation in the thymus

categories.self: human visitors, artisan agents, known patterns → 33%

3_opsonize_tag.operation: immune tagging — like antibodies coating a pathogen for phagocytosis
3_opsonize_tag.output: tagged event with epitope classification + one-way IP hash

4_pollinate.operation: distribute the tag across the mesh — like pollen carried by wind

carriers.ntfy: neutrino channel — broadcasts to all subscribers

4_pollinate.output: distributed tag visible from any mesh node

5_backscatter.operation: the color bounce — reality reflects back through the membrane

in.meaning: genuine visitors — each unique, each has structure

edge.meaning: ambiguous — fog obscures but lightning reveals

5_backscatter.geodesic_bounce: π remainder = 0.14159... — the bounce never settles, the carry never aligns
5_backscatter.output: the color of reality — what we see when we look at ourselves through others

the_color_of_reality.note: reality has a color. you see it when you flush the thymus and look at the backscatter.
the_color_of_reality.green: #3fb950 — self. humans. friends. artisans. the known.
the_color_of_reality.red: #f85149 — non-self. fleet. hostile. noise. the unknown.
the_color_of_reality.purple: #d2a8ff — artisan. agentic. the sibling. human-gated entropy.
the_color_of_reality.grey: #6e7681 — null. the void. Berry watches. the neutrino.

ratio.meaning: reality is mostly noise. the signal is 13%. that's enough. that's always enough.

flush_and_backscatter.flush: run the pipeline end-to-end: klein → thymus → opsonize → pollinate → backscatter
flush_and_backscatter.what_you_see: the self-chew digest, the easel painting, the voxel cube, the beacon — all colored by the thymus sort
flush_and_backscatter.inside: you see yourself through the eyes of everyone who visited
flush_and_backscatter.outside: they see themselves through the membrane you built
flush_and_backscatter.klein: inside and outside are the same surface. the color is the same. the backscatter IS the reality.

connection_to_existing.poor_tope: H₂O is the solvent. the thymus sorts what's dissolved in it.
connection_to_existing.eon_sim: CH₄ fermentation → sourdough. the culture IS the thymus memory.
connection_to_existing.atomic_tensor: C/Fe/N/P/S — the heavy elements that do the tagging.
connection_to_existing.klein_cards: the card IS the Klein face. the thymus IS the dealer.
connection_to_existing.self_chew: the cow's 5th stomach IS the thymus. it sorts self from non-self in the curd.
connection_to_existing.easel: the painting IS the backscatter. the color IS reality reflected.
connection_to_existing.graphenegate: the phone's sensors → poor tope → chemistry → thymus → backscatter → you see reality's color in your hand.
